title: The Billionaire's Masquerade
APPLY_TARGET_WARNING: titles.csv holds TWO similar rows and they are NOT duplicates: 'The Billionaire's Masquerade' (the-billionaire-s-masquerade) is a REELSHORT title with 2 cast, and 'Billionaire's Masquerade' (billionaire-s-masquerade) is the CANDYJAR one with none. This IMDb page displays WITH the article but its official site is CandyJar and its company is Inkitt Media, so it is the CandyJar production. Matching on the title string alone would attach all 7 of these people to the wrong show on the wrong platform. Apply to billionaire-s-masquerade only. This is the leading-article trap in the traps list, in its most dangerous form: the article variant is a real, different title rather than a spelling slip.
